comment: Independent C-first fatal burning-oil blast: debug Wizard wishes a lit oil potion, throws it upward, and is killed when it falls on his head. C explode.c:656-660 attributes the positive-type BURNING_OIL explosion as caught himself in his own burning oil. Old JS matches 2772 RNG and 36 cursors, differing only on the final tombstone. The existing lit-oil monster-target recording is a nonfatal blast control.
